python3 -c "
import os,glob
for base in ['/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp001_n17/results','/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp003/judgment_data_n17']:
    print(f'=== {base} ===')
    if not os.path.isdir(base):
        print('  NOT FOUND')
        continue
    for d in sorted(os.listdir(base)):
        dp=os.path.join(base,d)
        if not os.path.isdir(dp): continue
        files=glob.glob(os.path.join(dp,'*.jsonl'))
        total=sum(sum(1 for _ in open(f)) for f in files)
        pct=total*100/18000
        print(f'  {d}: {total} lines ({pct:.1f}%)')
"
